scope: Legacy RPC wallet indexer provider, outbox, and status failures

behavior.wallet_failures: Provider and per-wallet failures retain only an exception-class summary in chain status and logs.
behavior.run_failures: Top-level failure status and caller-visible errors are bounded; outbox failures retain OutboxEnqueueError type and fixed summary.
behavior.transaction_behavior: Per-wallet savepoints, whole-run rollback on outbox failure, same-connection status persistence, commit, and close behavior are preserved.

coverage: secret-bearing wallet RPC exception redacted from chain status and logs
secret-bearing outbox exception redacted from status and caller while rollback and exception type remain
top-level lookup failure is sanitized, context-suppressed, rolled back, and closed
successful and partial wallet transaction contracts remain intact

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; mocked connections and RPC boundaries only

limitations: No EVM RPC provider or database was contacted.
This does not add historical transaction scanning or prove confirmation-depth/reorg completeness.
